diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence but the IR requires a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period between body completions. F2 shows the IR fires at 190000 ms (after the first 10s delay) while the candidate has no mechanism to re-arm. The candidate's final delay(3 MIN) is incorrect; it should not delay after the body completes, but rather the wrapper period should be 3 MIN.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 180000 (3 MIN) to implement the repeating cycle. Removed the trailing delay(3 MIN) from the script body so the body executes immediately upon wrapping, and the wrapper period handles the 3-minute interval before the next firing.
